Initial release — introduces a workflow helper skill for self-improving, proactive agent-style productivity needs.

- Provides practical support for creating, hardening, and improving agent workflows with validated demand.
- Outlines clear steps: restate user needs, generate actionable plans and artifacts, minimize manual coordination, and ensure local-hardware compatibility.
- Delivers concise, reusable outputs (checklists, workflows, templates) tailored to user requirements.
- Includes self-validation criteria to ensure relevance, clarity, and actionable results.
- Triggered by common productivity and self-improvement keywords.
